messages:
maria: quick async check — Q2 milestone fencepost. Please reply with 'shipped' or 'slipped' and one-line blocker. Owners: runtime, infra, routing, product. I'll compile.

Tom R.: runtime — shipped. Canary rollout started, PR #4213 merged, logs https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4213 :tada:

Sasha I.: infra — slipped. Hit perf regression on 4k sequences during internal canary; suspect kernel selection mismatch. Blocker: need debug window on dedicated pool (can't replicate on smaller shards).

kai (Product): routing policy change still unowned. We need an explicit owner for cross-region fallback and cost-tier routing. Suggest @lee.

Lee C.: happy to take routing policy ownership. Will draft a short RFC + rollout guardrails by EOD.

Anita P.: quota ask — can we bump dedicated GPU pool to accommodate canary traffic? Pinging infra on this thread.

maria: CR ping @tom on PR #4213 — can you add the perf test harness and a smoke script so infra can validate?

Tom R.: on it, adding a harness + smoke script. Example I’ll add to PR:
```
python perf_test.py --model gpt-small --seq 4096 --batch 4 --iterations 20
```
Should help reproduce locally.

Sasha I.: infra ops note — blocked on maintenance calendar. Proposed window: Thu 00:30-02:30 UTC (needs approval from SRE).

kai (Product): product acceptance — once latency < target and error-rate stable, we flip rollout to 50%. Who owns rollback?

Lee C.: assigning rollback play to @sasha + @tom (shared). I’ll add a small rollback checklist to the runbook page.

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary-start @2024-06-12T09:30:00Z — status: queued.

maria: thanks. I'll compile into the milestone tracker by EOD. Quick next-steps list (callouts):
- tom: add perf harness + CI perf job (due: 2d)
- sasha: debug kernel selection + confirm maintenance window (due: 1d)
- lee: RFC for routing policy + rollout guardrails (due: EOD)
- anita: quota bump confirmation (due: 12h)
- kai: confirm acceptance criteria (due: 2d)

Sasha I.: noted and will update when maintenance window confirmed. :thumbsup:

Lee C.: RFC draft will be dropped here when ready.

maria: great — ping this thread as items land and I’ll mark shipped/slipped in the sheet. /cc @eng-leads
